description.en: Handcrafted plugins for the DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的插件。
读取工作区结构，把模糊的许愿按六个维度体检一遍：交付物、落点、受众、硬约束、验收标准、范围。指出还缺什么、每项建议怎么补，并给出可直接使用的工作说明。支持场景模板、图形化维度配置，以及从会话日志精确统计的体检次数与歧义数。
description.en: Reads the workspace and audits a wish across six dimensions: deliverable, destination, audience, constraints, acceptance, scope. Reports what is still missing, a default for each gap, and a ready-to-use brief. Includes scenario templates, a graphical dimension editor, and exact check/gap counts folded from the session log.
